Everyday Sparks

Micro-Credential

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This microcredential recognizes your engagement with the Everyday Sparks module and your thoughtful reflection on how everyday moments can inspire meaningful writing. By exploring strategies like keeping a Writer’s Notebook, brainstorming with Quicklists, and building writing stamina with Writing Sprints, you’ve demonstrated a commitment to cultivating literacy routines that empower students to see the writing potential in their daily lives.

Criteria

To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:

  • A specific strategy from the module you plan to try with your students.

  • A brief note about any challenges you anticipate and how you might address them.

  • How often you see yourself using this kind of routine writing practice.

  • An uploaded example (such as a Quicklist prompt, Writing Sprint directions, or Writer’s Notebook setup) showing how you might use the strategy in your classroom.
